login.tagline: Record in-person meetings and get a transcript with each speaker's name, ready for your minutes.
login.onlyList: Only people on the access list can sign in. No passwords.
login.sent: If {email} is on the access list, a sign-in link is on its way. It expires in 30 minutes.
login.retention: Your meetings are private and are deleted automatically after 30 days.

access.webHint: Tap the button to sign in on this browser.
access.appHint: This link is for the minuteca recorder on your iPhone.
access.appOnlyHere: Open it on the same iPhone where you asked for the link.

app.signOutConfirm: A recording is in progress. Stop it and sign out? The audio stays saved on this device.
app.placementTip: Place the device in the middle of the table. Audio is saved on this device every 5 seconds, so a crash or reload won't lose the meeting.
app.recordingBanner: Recording in progress: back to the recorder

errors.unsupported: This browser does not support audio recording. Use a recent Chrome, Edge, Firefox or Safari.
errors.micDenied: Microphone access was denied. Allow it in the browser's site settings and try again.
errors.micNotFound: No microphone was found. Connect one and try again.
errors.systemAudioNotSupported: This browser does not support system audio recording. Use Chrome, Edge, or Firefox.
errors.systemAudioFailed: Could not capture system audio: {message}. Make sure to allow audio when selecting your screen.
errors.diskWarning: Could not save audio to local storage (disk full?). Recording continues in memory: don't close this tab until it's transcribed.
errors.recorderError: Recorder error: {message}. Audio captured so far is saved.
errors.micDisconnected: The microphone disconnected. Recording stopped; audio captured so far is saved.

recorder.destinationAuto: When you stop, the audio is uploaded to minuteca and transcribed with {provider}.
recorder.destinationAsk: When you stop, the audio is uploaded to minuteca. We will ask before transcribing it with {provider}.
recorder.destinationNoKey: When you stop, the audio is uploaded to minuteca. To transcribe it, add a provider key in Settings.
recorder.iosNotice: On iPhone, the browser stops recording when the screen locks or you switch apps. For meetings, use the minuteca recorder for iPhone.

recovery.discardConfirm: Permanently discard this recording? This cannot be undone.

status.failed: The recording could not be uploaded
status.safe: The recording is safe on this device.
status.keepOpen: Keep this tab open until the upload finishes.
status.usuallyFast: It usually takes less than a minute, even for long meetings.

importAudio.title: Recorded with another app?
importAudio.hint: Drop an audio or video file here (MP3, M4A, WAV, OGG, MP4…, up to {size} MB). For example, an iPhone voice memo from Files.
importAudio.notAudio: “{name}” doesn't look like an audio or video file.
importAudio.onlyFirst: Only the first file was uploaded. Add the others one at a time.

history.label: Meeting history
history.empty: No meetings yet. They are kept for 30 days and show up on all your devices.
history.retentionNote: Kept for 30 days · on all your devices

meeting.title: Meeting title
meeting.notFound: This meeting no longer exists. Meetings are deleted automatically after 30 days.
meeting.retention: Meetings, transcripts and audio are kept for 30 days and then deleted automatically. Export what you need to keep.
meeting.providerHint: The provider that processed this meeting's audio.
meeting.waitingAudio: This meeting has no audio yet. If you recorded it on the iPhone, open the recorder so it finishes uploading.

transcript.title: Transcript
transcript.empty: No speech was detected in this recording.
transcript.wrongSpeaker: Wrong speaker? Click to reassign this block

exportBar.clipboardFailed: Could not access the clipboard. Use Download .txt instead.
exportBar.removeAudioConfirm: Delete this meeting's audio from your account? The transcript is kept.

users.title: Users
users.subtitle: People who can sign in and transcribe. Admins can also change this list.
users.removeConfirm: Remove {email}'s access? They will no longer be able to sign in. Their meetings are deleted when they expire.
users.hint: The person signs in with a link sent to that email. Changes apply right away.

pwa.iosStep2: Scroll down the menu, or tap “More” (…) in the bottom row, and choose “Add to Home Screen”
pwa.iosStep3: Turn on “Open as Web App” if shown, then tap “Add”. Open Minuteca from its icon.
pwa.updateAvailable: A new version of Minuteca is available.
pwa.updateAfterRecording: A new version is ready. Update after this recording.

transcribe.destination: The audio will leave minuteca for {provider} ({where}) to be transcribed.
transcribe.paidOwn: Your key is used: {provider} charges your account.
transcribe.paidHosted: The service's key is used, at no cost to you, within this month's cap.
transcribe.noKey: To transcribe with {provider}, add your key in Settings or pick another provider.
transcribe.inProgress: Transcribing with {provider} and telling speakers apart…
transcribe.failed: The transcription failed: {reason} The audio is still saved; you can retry.

consent.title: Send the audio to {provider}?
consent.body: To transcribe, minuteca sends the meeting audio to {provider} ({where}), an artificial intelligence service that turns speech into text.
consent.others: The recording includes other people's voices. Send it only if your work and the people present allow it.
consent.revoke: This permission is kept for {provider}. You can withdraw it at any time in Settings.

deepgram.name: Deepgram
deepgram.privacy: Every request asks it not to use your audio to improve its models.

assemblyai.name: AssemblyAI
assemblyai.privacy: It does not train on customer audio today, but its terms allow it: with your own key, opt out in its dashboard (Data Controls). When it finishes, minuteca deletes the transcript from its servers.

openai.name: OpenAI
openai.privacy: Per its policy, it does not train on API audio. It accepts files of up to 25 MB.

share.title: Share the transcript
share.warning: The transcript will leave minuteca for the app you choose (for example ChatGPT or Gemini), which handles it under its own rules. It includes what each person said.
share.how: On a phone, the share menu opens with the text and a .txt file. On a computer, the text is copied with instructions: paste it into the AI app.
share.copied: Copied. Paste it into ChatGPT, Gemini or the AI app you use and it will write the minutes.
share.prompt: Using the following meeting transcript, write the minutes: date, attendees, topics discussed, agreements and action items with owner and due date. Do not invent anything that is not in the transcript.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Transcription provider, your keys, permissions and your data.
settings.providersHint: Pick which one transcribes. You can use your own key for any of them, free in minuteca: the provider bills you.
settings.keysDisabled: This server has no encryption key configured, so it cannot store your own keys.
settings.removeKeyConfirm: Delete your key? It is deleted from minuteca; it keeps working at the provider until you revoke it there.
settings.replaceKey: Paste a new key to replace it
settings.keySafety: Your key is checked with the provider, stored encrypted and never shown again: only its last 4 characters. It is only used for your transcriptions.
settings.hostedLeft: {left} of {cap} min left this month for everyone.
settings.dataHint: Everything is deleted automatically after {days} days. Download your meetings and transcripts as JSON at any time.
settings.iosHint: On iPhone, record with the minuteca app (installed with TestFlight): it keeps recording with the screen locked or during a call, and uploads when there is signal. Recordings show up here to transcribe.

errors.network: Could not reach minuteca. Check your connection.
errors.bad_origin: Request blocked for security. Reload the page.
errors.invalid_challenge: The recorder sent an invalid request.
errors.too_many: Too many attempts. Wait a minute.
errors.mail_failed: We could not send the email. Try again in a few minutes.
errors.link_expired: This link was already used or has expired.
errors.not_allowed: That email is not on the access list.
errors.signed_out: You were signed out. Sign in again.
errors.keys_disabled: This server cannot store your own keys.
errors.invalid_key: The provider did not accept that key.
errors.provider_unavailable: Could not reach the provider. Try again.
errors.invalid_speakers: The speaker change could not be saved.
errors.not_audio: That file is not audio or video.
errors.length_required: The file size could not be read.
errors.upload_incomplete: The upload did not finish. Your audio is saved; try again.
errors.no_consent: First allow sending the audio to that provider.
errors.no_key: There is no key for that provider. Add yours in Settings.
errors.hosted_cap: The service's minutes for this month are used up. Use your own key or wait for next month.
errors.self: You cannot remove yourself or a fixed admin.
errors.server_error: The server had a problem. Try again.
errors.unprocessable: The provider could not process this audio.
errors.not_converting: The meeting is not waiting for conversion.
errors.invalid_transcript: The transcript received is not valid.

{link}

minuteca
